description: Decode drinking-water identifiers, contaminant codes, coverage and regulatory terminology before filtering records. identifiers, system_types, sources, standards and coverage are bundled reviewed reference; contaminants, violation_types, enforcement_types, treatment and service_areas retrieve the public EPA dictionary. Exact codes remain meaningful when a description is missing. Standards distinguish MCL, MCLG and action level and never classify historical rows as exceedances. UCMR analytes and SDWIS contaminant codes are separate namespaces; choose an explicit dataset in sdwis_search_contaminants.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool; retain exactly the original selectors.

limit.description: Inline items requested; values above the effective maximum 100 are clamped with a notice.

query.description: Case-insensitive exact-field substring search within the selected reference topic.

record_cursor.description: Signed oversized-record pointer returned by this same tool; use with view text.

topic.description: Bundled interpretation topic or live EPA dictionary topic.

view.description: Records by default; text reads an oversized record losslessly using record_cursor.

name: sdwis_list_reference

pointer.description: Executable next steps for the canvas capability.

source_complete.description: Whether this staged partition contains the entire selected source.

effective_filters.description: Normalized effective selection; state_basis identifies legal-entity state matching.

encoding.description: Concatenated text is the exact serialized JSON record.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `selection_capacity_exhausted`: Live selections or retained source data reached the process capacity. `cursor_invalid`: Reference cursor expired or topic/query changed. `upstream_contract_changed`: Live reference rows fail the public table contract. `upstream_paging_changed`: Live reference paging repeats without progress. `item_too_large`: A full reference description exceeds inline capacity. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_more.description: Whether the indicated continuation has more work.

items.description: Complete public source rows, never truncated strings.
Flat allowlisted source fields; null represents unknown source data.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation pointing at the first unconsumed item or source work.

offset.description: Unicode code-point offset of this chunk.

published_release.description: Publisher release label, distinct from HTTP modification and observation dates.

retrieved_at.description: HTTP retrieval time, not observation or snapshot time.

record_identity.description: Identity of the oversized record being read.

returned.description: Items in this response, not a total.

selection_partition.description: Delivered source position; membership-only work has no position.

final_partition.description: Final source partition when exhaustion is known; otherwise null.

selection_id.description: Stable identity of this source retrieval.

source_complete.description: All selected source rows are contained in this output or its current staged partition; false after earlier rows were delivered.

truncated.description: True when this inline preview omits retained or unfetched source rows; follow the exact continuation or live dataset.
